defect_observations.label: def:p02-w02-p02-005-idiom-limits
defect_observations.observation: Suspected inaccuracy (correctness, not coverage): 'The step from neg neg Q -> P to Q -> P uses double negation and fails intuitionistically.' Read as an inference, neg neg Q -> P entails Q -> P intuitionistically (it needs only Q -> neg neg Q); what fails intuitionistically is the converse, hence the equivalence used for the simplification. Rewording to 'the equivalence ... fails intuitionistically (the direction from Q -> P to neg neg Q -> P needs double-negation elimination)' would remove the ambiguity.
